messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

set: ["relaxes muscles in the airways", "tighten the airways", "narrowing of the airways in the lungs", "narrowing of the airways", "relaxes skeletal muscle", "beta-2 receptors in the airways and blood vessels", "stiff muscles", "floppy muscles", "muscles themselves", "widens airways", "very stiff (rigid) muscles", "tight, overactive muscles to relax", "swelling of face and airways", "improving glucose uptake by muscles", "throw the bag in the trash", "taken in the morning"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
